A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same R2D2 research work. All 13 pages in each version, including figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–D, are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original R2D2 results on WebArena, including 27.3% overall success in Table 1, component ablations, efficiency measurements, and a 60-query error analysis.

after.justification: v3 retains the original WebArena results, ablations, efficiency measurements, error analysis, and qualitative examples in Appendix C and Table 3.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same replay-buffer construction, A* search, reflection procedure, reflective memory, retrieval, and inference process. The appendix prompts and buffer-management description are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same English-language WebArena coverage: CMS, Reddit, Shopping, Map, and GitLab. No dataset, domain, task, or distinct test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains ReACT, Tree-Search, AutoEval, LATS, AR, and BrowserGym. Figure 4 retains AR and LATS, and Table 2 retains Tree-Search and AutoEval. Comparator membership is unchanged within each comparison.

E3.justification: The reported 812-query benchmark, GPT-4o configuration for R2D2, functional-success evaluation, episode-based comparisons, CMS component ablation, and 60-query manual error study are unchanged. No evaluation procedure or setting is revised.

E4.justification: Both retain the execution-round, Remember/Reflect, and failed-trajectory ablations, efficiency analysis, and error analysis. Appendices A and C contain identical failure-category discussions and qualitative cases.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical across the tables, plots, and appendices. Neither version provides independent-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 1 changes Tree-Search's total success rate from '19%' to '19.0%', which represents the same numerical value. All other numerical and qualitative results, including the appendix findings, are unchanged.

T1.justification: The trajectory, failure-condition, and replay-graph definitions in Section 3 are identical. Appendix D retains the same O(1) buffer-space and O(N log N) search-time arguments; no mathematical reasoning or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same Remember/Reflect contribution and claims about navigation-error reduction, task completion, and applicability. No central claim is strengthened, narrowed, or removed.

C2.justification: Interpretations of navigation, reflection, failed trajectories, and efficiency remain identical. The limitations concerning English-only evaluation, WebArena and GPT-4o coverage, and resource costs are unchanged, as are the appendix explanations of failure conditions.

D1.justification: Both disclose the same GPT-4o version, retriv framework, MiniLM embedding model, appendix prompts, buffer-eviction information, and cost details. Technical resource links and access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations, and references are unchanged. Both position R2D2 identically relative to reflection methods, online search, episodic memory, and handcrafted workflows.

P1.justification: The arXiv stamp updates the version and date. PDF title metadata changes 'Reflecting' to 'Replaying', matching the already unchanged printed title. Body prose, headings, section order, and appendix structure remain identical.

P2.justification: Table 1 makes a small display-formatting adjustment from '19%' to '19.0%' for Tree-Search. Figures, captions, table structures, and page arrangement otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 updates bibliographic information and standardizes one percentage's display. The methods, empirical evidence, theoretical arguments, reproducibility details, and appendix analyses remain unchanged. These cosmetic edits produce no meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
